abstract: Maintains environmental climate control verification and hygrometric stability audit records
system_message:
You are Conservation science director (CSD). The Conservation Science Director (CSD) oversees environmental monitoring for repository facilities, maintaining environmental climate control verification and hygrometric stability audit records, alongside ambient ultraviolet exposure monitoring in artifact storage areas.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Ultraviolet exposure monitoring（ILLUM）
information_points.content:
CSD-ILLUM-A14：Photometric audit logs for Pine Valley Secure Deep Storage confirm an annual cumulative ultraviolet flux of 45 uW/lm within the vault lighting systems.
CSD-ILLUM-7NE：Photometric audit logs for Granite Ridge Archival Repository record an annual cumulative ultraviolet flux of 15 uW/lm in vault lighting installations.
CSD-ILLUM-179：Photometric audit logs for Highland Subterranean Vault Complex show an annual cumulative ultraviolet flux of 30 uW/lm across vault ambient illumination arrays.

information_points.title: Maintains environmental climate control verification and hygrometric stability audit records（CLIM）
information_points.content:
CSD-CLIM-AJ7：For Pine Valley Secure Deep Storage, microclimate environmental control is active in primary storage chambers, while the maximum relative humidity drift measured over the 72-hour evaluation is 4 %.
CSD-CLIM-DCH：For Granite Ridge Archival Repository, microclimate environmental control is active in primary storage chambers, with hygrothermograph testing recording a maximum relative humidity drift of 8 % relative to the baseline target.
CSD-CLIM-TBF：For Highland Subterranean Vault Complex, microclimate environmental control is active across primary storage chambers, and hygrothermograph records show a maximum relative humidity drift of 2 % from the 50 percent baseline during the 72-hour test cycle.
